craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the sheltered. Device: dash→comma + semicolon→comma (shelter stated softly throughout). Rejected: translating the mantra ('to Śiva' glossed) — killed: the Name stands unglossed, row 10. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail, hail — 'to Śiva', mantled in chant-force they shelter,
laudable they, bent to quaff Śāmbhavī weal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge.; Praiseworthy they, striving to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune. → Praiseworthy are those striving for Śāmbhavī fortune by mantra-power.
c1_essence: Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
reads_against.l2: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge, praiseworthy they who strive to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune.

reads_against.t1: Homage, homage, to Śiva — by mantra-power taking refuge: praiseworthy those who strive to enjoy your Śāmbhavī bhūti.
